name: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
problem: Linear-attention hybrids had not beaten full attention under fair comparison, and linear attention's finite recurrent state was the suspected cause.
mechanism: Introduces Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), a linear attention module that extends Gated DeltaNet with a finer-grained gating mechanism so the model makes better use of a limited finite-state RNN memory, plus a bespoke chunkwise algorithm built on a specialised Diagonal-Plus-Low-Rank (DPLR) transition matrix that substantially reduces computation versus the general DPLR formulation. The shipped model, Kimi Linear 48B-A3B, is an MoE hybrid: 3B parameters active per token out of 48B total (about 6.25 percent active), with a gated-delta linear-attention pattern rather than Mamba's scalar-selective SSM. The attention pattern is hybrid: a majority of layers use KDA and a minority use full attention, which is the specific design choice worth carrying into serving work because the full-attention layers are what bound the KV cache. Constant-size state within the linear layers means those layers add no length-dependent memory.
speedup_reported: Claims to be the first hybrid linear-attention architecture to outperform full attention under fair comparison across short-context, long-context and RL-scaling regimes, and reports lower KV cache usage and faster decoding than full-attention baselines of comparable quality. The report gives cache-size and decode-throughput comparisons rather than a single speedup ratio; hardware is reported as H200/H800-class. Treat the 'outperforms full attention' claim as the authors' own fair-comparison framing rather than an independently reproduced result.
notes: arXiv preprint (v2 2025-11-01); no journal-ref on the abs page. Engine support is verified and unusually recent for a new architecture: llama.cpp has LLM_ARCH_KIMI_LINEAR inside llm_arch_is_hybrid() plus a dedicated conversion/kimi_linear.py, and vLLM has a native KimiLinearForCausalLM row listing Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Base and -Instruct. This is the best-evidenced 'new linear-attention hybrid is genuinely servable' case in the slice.
